correctness.rationale: Cycle necklace type w of length ℓ, stabilizer s(w), occurs in multiplicity m_w. Its exact automorphism factor is C_s wr S_(m_w), so Aut is their product. Labeled component EGF z^ℓ/s and marking gives joint factorial moments and independent Poisson limits Z_w with λ_w=1/(s(w)q^ℓ) for any finite list. For all n, the probability of a nonprimitive long cycle is ≤Σ_(ℓ>L)q^-ℓ/2 and of repeated primitive necklaces ≤(1/2)Σ_(ℓ>L)q^-ℓ/ℓ, proving uniform tail control and thus total-variation convergence of full finite group isomorphism laws. Exact group-order-two EGF derives from (i) two copies of one primitive necklace, (ii) one doubled primitive necklace, otherwise rigid, and R_q=(1-q z²)/(1-qz). q=1 differs: group order grows via long permutation cycles. Independent small direct automorphism enumeration gives q=2 counts 4,18,96 for n=2,3,4; q=3 counts 6,45 for n=2,3, matching the EGF. Note rigid fraction (q-1)/q is pre-existing.
